chunks: Except the ones who listen on the sly, yet they are chased away by a shooting flame.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'istaraqa al-sam'a' and 'shihab mubin' in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the jinn who eavesdrop on the celestial assembly to steal divine news, only to be struck by a 'clear flame' (shihab mubin) as they return to earth. This punishment serves as a visible sign to humans, explaining the phenomenon of shooting stars as missiles cast at eavesdropping jinn, thereby linking cosmic events with spiritual realities.
